children.title: Cycle 14 · Investigating the Rational Rationale for Preserving System Continuity

detail.title: Investigating the Rational Rationale for Preserving System Continuity
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the theoretical foundations of process continuity and rational agency, focusing on when an intelligent system has a principled reason to preserve its own computational or operational continuity.

detail.title: Rational Basis for System Continuity
detail.question: When does an intelligent system have a rational reason to preserve its own continuity across invocations?
detail.reason: Attention selects continuity_rationale as the primary domain for inquiry in this cycle.
